phase1.evidence: Accepted actual instruction fetch, decoded in effective PRG context; analysis/round01-session-rpc.jsonl and round01-all-candidates.json.

regions.summary: Preserve registers and flags, reset the PPU address latch and DMA the OAM shadow. Execute the pending VRAM transfer, restore scroll, increment the frame clock and release frame waiters. Temporarily select bank 0 for music/effects, restore the interrupted bank and optionally animate board markers before RTI. The IRQ vector also points here; that does not prove general IRQ compatibility.

Execute the pending VRAM transfer, restore scroll, increment the frame clock and release frame waiters. Temporarily select bank 0 for music/effects, restore the interrupted bank and optionally animate board markers before RTI. The IRQ vector also points here; that does not prove general IRQ compatibility.

phase1.evidence: Accepted actual instruction fetch, decoded in effective PRG context; analysis/round01-session-rpc.jsonl and round01-all-candidates.json.
